主要内容: The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) is scheduled to release its annual GDP statistics update on July 30, 2020. This update will include revised GDP estimates for the first quarter of 2020 and the previous five years. The BEA utilizes newly available data and methodological improvements to refine earlier GDP estimates, which are the most comprehensive measure of U.S. economic activity. This year’s update will cover quarterly and annual estimates for 2015 through the first quarter of 2020, with selected updates of income and saving reaching back further. The annual update will be released alongside the first estimate of second quarter GDP at 8:30 a.m. on July 30. The update will incorporate more complete and detailed data from various sources, including the Census Bureau, the federal budget, the IRS, and the Agricultural Department. Additionally, the update will reflect ongoing work to harmonize BEA’s National Income and Product Accounts with its industry statistics. The July update will also include improvements such as the results of the annual update of BEA’s international transactions accounts, updates to seasonal factors, and new subcategories of private fixed investment in intellectual property products. The BEA will also provide downloadable resources, including Acrobat Reader for accessing the detailed reports. The last modification to the page was made on July 13, 2020, indicating the latest update to the release schedule and information.
